# Agent Monitor

> Real-time, multi-session workflow monitor and timeline visualizer for AI Coding Agents. Officially supports Cursor Agent, ZCode, and Codex (CLI & Desktop).

Agent Monitor provides a local dark-themed web dashboard and an ultra-fast, zero-dependency CLI event reporter (`agent-reporter`) that intercepts AI agent lifecycle hooks with microsecond latency and streams live multi-turn execution traces to the UI over Server-Sent Events (SSE).

## AI Agent Integration

For AI Coding Agents that want to automatically self-configure hooks for the current project:
- [Agent Integration Manual](docs/AGENT_INTEGRATION.md): Step-by-step instructions for AI agents to auto-detect their environment and configure hooks.
- [Installation Guide](docs/INSTALLATION.md): Complete guide for installing, offline distribution, Docker, and systemd service management.
- [Parallel Agents](docs/PARALLEL_AGENTS.en.md): Concurrent Cursor Agents on isolated Git worktrees / Cloud Agents and `feat/` `fix/` GitHub PRs. Do not write the same checkout.
- [Complete Development Roadmap](docs/DEVELOPMENT_ROADMAP.en.md): Capability baseline, known correctness/security gaps, phased work packages, migration strategy, tests, acceptance criteria, and PR sequencing.
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/Zelayan/agent-monitor): Source code, releases, and documentation.

## Core Components

- `agent-monitor`: The backend HTTP & SSE dashboard service written in pure Go (embeds the frontend SPA). Optional OpenAI-compatible LLM titles via `AGENT_MONITOR_LLM_BASE_URL` / `AGENT_MONITOR_LLM_MODEL` / `AGENT_MONITOR_LLM_API_KEY`; session `goalSummary` interval via `AGENT_MONITOR_LLM_GOAL_EVERY_N` (default 3, `0` disables). `rootGoal` stays the first-prompt original.
- `agent-reporter`: Zero-dependency static CLI binary called by agent hooks (`--event`, `--agent`, `--turn`).
- `http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/event`: HTTP POST endpoint for hook ingestion.
- `http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/stream`: SSE live update stream.

## Quick CLI Installation

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Zelayan/agent-monitor/main/install.sh | bash
```

## Hook Recipes by Agent

- **Cursor Agent** (Officially Supported): `.cursor/hooks.json` with `sessionStart`, `beforeSubmitPrompt`, `preToolUse`, `postToolUseFailure`, `beforeShellExecution`, `beforeMCPExecution`, `subagentStart`, `afterAgentResponse`, `stop`, `sessionEnd`.
- **ZCode** (Officially Supported): `.zcode/config.json` with `SessionStart`, `UserPromptSubmit`, `PreToolUse`, `PostToolUseFailure`, `Stop`.
- **Codex CLI / Desktop** (Officially Supported): `.codex/hooks.json` with `sessionStart`, `beforeSubmitPrompt`, `preToolUse`, `postToolUseFailure`, `beforeShellExecution`, `beforeMCPExecution`, `subagentStart`, `afterAgentResponse`, `stop`, `sessionEnd`.
- **Other Agents (In Progress / Pending)**: Claude Code, Aider, Continue, Windsurf, Trae. See docs/AGENT_INTEGRATION.md for experimental recipes.
